scope: Retained six cases from R149/R150; excludes four newly generated cases. CPU extraction only. All 36 trajectories have 20 Euler updates.
measurement_notes: Reported averages use recorded sampling intervals, never end-to-end job time divided by steps.
Exact 24 recorder timers include x0 capture and audit I/O; individual callbacks include setup in the first interval and prior Euler update in later intervals.
Twelve historical tqdm timings report rounded loop total and final average; no exact individual step timing was recorded.
Recorder timestamp envelope is retained separately and does not replace sampler measurement.
Per-method all-case averages describe observed runs with mixed hardware; use matched subsets for method comparisons.
Historical prompt hashes are preserved; these six cases retain their historical prompts.
